description.value:
Cast 3 days of downtime

Requirement You have the Marrow Deep feat and would otherwise use it or Second Graft.

Cost 6 Vitae

Marrow Deep can graft a Major mutation instead of a Minor one, at added cost and downtime.

When you use Marrow Deep or Second Graft, you may choose a mutation from the Bloom Table's Major Mutation entries instead of the Minor entries, at triple the usual downtime and Vitae cost. Everything else about the procedure — permanence, no maintenance, the once-per-level limit it shares with the ordinary use — is unchanged.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Also depends on fleshmancer.marrow-deep.json, itself rules: [] -- see that card's own disposition.
